notes.subject: רזון
notes.rationale: Razon (thinness) — em i wanpela tok hia tasol long olgeta Tanakh; 'efa i sot' i holim piksa.

notes.subject: זעומה
notes.rationale: Zaumah (foam bilong bel hevi/ol i kros) — wanpela ples hia tasol.

notes.subject: איפת
notes.rationale: Efa — mak bilong skelim kaikai; pasin bilong skelim i no stret em i singaut bilong ves.

notes.subject: האש...עוד
notes.rationale: Kruseder i no gat wanpela mining: KJV 'are there yet?' vs BSB 'can I forget any longer?'

translation: I gat yet a, long haus bilong man nogut, ol stua bilong pasin nogut, na efa i sot — em i samting ol i les long em tru?

tokens.gloss: ol i les long em tru
